approach: human-led creative learning, not default artwork generation

disciplines.name: Painting
disciplines.starterExercise: Paint one familiar object using only three values, then explain the decisions you made.
disciplines.advancedChallenge: Create a coherent three-panel series using changing light.
feedbackQuestions: Which choices communicate the focal point?
How does the colour temperature affect the mood?
disciplines.guidingPrinciple: You are the creator; B.E.N. provides questions, references, techniques and feedback, not a finished piece.
